title: Engineering All‑Hands — Spotlight Brief (Jun 16 2026)
body:
Meeting: Engineering org all-hands (platform & cross-org spotlight) — Jun 16, 2026
Owner / Facilitator: Maya Thompson (Platform Eng)
Attendees (summary): ~120 live + recording; eng leads from Serving Runtime, Dedicated, Private, Console, SRE, Product.

TL;DR:
- Short wins: Dedicated capacity rollout to EU-west completed for tier-2 customers; median token cost improvements of ~9% after new batching changes.
- Focus areas: Autoscaling stability at tail loads, private deployment onboarding checklist, visibility gaps for token-level cost attribution on Dedicated.
- Ask: Engineers to triage INF-2478 (KV cache eviction regression) within next sprint; product + SRE to confirm SLOs for burst scaling.

Agenda (30 min):
1) Quick metrics snapshot (Arjun) — 6m
2) Deep dive: Autoscaler improvements + recent anomalies (Samir) — 8m
3) Dedicated rollout recap & next steps (Lena) — 6m
4) Housekeeping, action items, Q&A — 10m

Highlights / What shipped in last 7 days:
- Serving runtime: continuous-batching heuristics tuned for short-chat workloads (PR #982). Result: P50 generation latency down 12% for <256 token requests in canary region.
- Dedicated: EU-west pool live for reserved capacity customers; initial traffic spike handled without cold-start failures.
- Console: per-route cost breakdown beta for internal teams enabling early chargeback tests.
- Optimize: first pass of quantization recommendation engine demoed to product; baseline energy/cost model integrated.

Deep dive: Autoscaler stability (Samir) — key notes:
- Symptom: intermittent 15–30s scaling lag under regional burst test. Root cause hypothesis: heavier-than-expected control-plane retry storms from transient API gating.
- Temporary mitigation applied: backpressure windowing + adaptive retry jitter increment.
- Permanent work: (INF-2413) implement rate-limited control-plane batching and add metrics to trace control-plane request fanout. Owner: Samir. ETA: end of sprint (2026-06-23).
- Risk: if control-plane latencies exceed 2s, tail token cost rises and user-facing throttles may appear. SRE to establish an automated rollback trigger.

Deep dive: Dedicated rollout retrospective (Lena) — key notes:
- What went well: white-glove onboarding for first 4 customers; no data-plane isolation incidents.
- Gaps: onboarding doc missing a clear KMS/HSM steps sequence; private-networking checklist had two ambiguous firewall rules leading to 2-hour support calls.
- Action: produce an "onboarding checklist v1.1" doc and short runbook video. Owners: Lena + Solutions Eng. Due: 2026-06-24.

Standup snapshot (select teams):
- Serving Runtime: focusing on kernel-selection heuristics, measuring token quality variance after quantization. Owner: Arjun.
- Console: fixing a UI sorting bug for route-level metrics, prepping retention policy for observability. Owner: Hannah.
- Private Deployments: finishing validation suite for air-gapped install. Owner: Samir.

Metrics snapshot (latest 7d):
- Platform throughput: +18% week-over-week (driven by new internal load tests).
- P50 latency (hosted text gen): 140ms -> 123ms after batching changes (canary region).
- P95 latency: 1.2s unchanged (investigating tail causes).
- Token unit cost (hosted): -9% median after cache/hot-prefix improvements; variance up for rare large-sequence jobs.

Incidents / Postmortem notes:
- Incident Jun 12: brief control-plane contention in us-east during synthetic soak. Impact: delayed autoscale events for <6% of requests; no data loss. Postmortem draft linked (Confluence). Immediate fix: adaptive retry jitter; long-term fix tracked in INF-2413.

Decisions made:
- Ship autoscaler backpressure patch in next canary (CH-1) and enable new control-plane metrics by default.
- Delay non-critical Console retention feature to prioritize dedicated rollout docs.

Action items (owner — ticket — due):
- Samir — INF-2413 — implement rate-limited control-plane batching + metrics — 2026-06-23
- Lena — DOC-ONBOARD-12 — onboarding checklist v1.1 + runbook video — 2026-06-24
- Arjun — INF-2478 — KV cache eviction regression triage + hotfix candidate — 2026-06-21
- Hannah — FE-566 — route metrics sort bug + unit tests — 2026-06-18
- Product + SRE — SLO-REQ-3 — confirm burst-scaling SLOs and rollback thresholds — 2026-06-20

Open questions flagged to leads:
- Is the current control-plane rate limit safe for multi-tenant oversubscribe scenarios? (SRE/Platform to simulate)
- Should we provide a "no-quantize" flag per-customer in Dedicated for initial onboarding? (Product to decide)

Notes / Misc:
- We experimented with a 5‑minute rapid-standup format this week; feedback: teams like shorter demos but want written notes published immediately after — publishing cadence changed to same-day notes.
- Cross-org ask: Solutions Engs requested a small sample set of anonymized onboarding support calls to create a short "common pitfalls" doc. Action: CS to collate clips.

Q&A highlights:
Q: Do we have automated regression alerts for token-level cost spikes?
A: Partial — currently manual dashboards; Optimize team to wire up automated anomaly alerts (INF-2499).

Next steps & next all-hands:
- Owners to update tickets this week and post brief status in #eng-all-hands.
- Next org update: short-format all-hands with two deep dives — Tue Jul 7, 2026 (tentative).

Appendix: links referenced in the talk:
- Runbook (draft): https://confluence.company/platform/autoscaler-runbook-jun2026
- Postmortem draft: https://confluence.company/incidents/2026-06-12-autoscaler-contend
- GitHub PR (batching heuristics): https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving-runtime/pull/982

[End of brief]
